# is a REAL source file, not a mock.
#   src/cli.c (entry commit)  the real production CLI parser                      FIRED   exit 1
#   fixed.c                   the policy dispatched on the PolyC-selected status  SILENT  exit 0

# the selector-ON region does not select and read the PolyC status at
# all. The detector distinguishes the two, so a failure names itself.
#   C_POLICY_PREEMPTS_POLYC_STATUS|REASON_DETAIL=the selector-ON region does not select and read the PolyC status
